candidate_relations.reason: The biopsy confirms non-keratinizing invasive SCC and p16-INK4a positivity (a surrogate marker for HPV association), making HPV-related SCC the complete diagnosis. C001 captures the anatomical site and histology but does not specify the HPV etiology, which is a required component of the benchmark reference.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Correctly identifies squamous cell carcinoma at the base/root of tongue but omits the HPV-related (p16-positive) etiology required by the reference diagnosis

case_quality_flags: Incidental EMG findings of active denervation in lumbar paraspinals and distal muscles are unexplained and may represent a separate process or artifact; not incorporated into the primary diagnosis
Right hypoglossal nerve palsy (tongue deviation/atrophy) is contralateral to the left-sided mass on CT, suggesting possible bilateral or midline involvement or perineural spread
